answer: What survives to the ridge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. A lagoon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the sonnet of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
